must_record: Every line of a product's formulation: the product, the ingredient or packaging item, and how much of it is used
Which version of the formulation each line belongs to
must_answer: What goes into this product, and what is inside each of those ingredients?
must_prevent: A product that ends up containing itself, however many steps away
A formulation put together from lines that belong to two different versions
prevent_how: The relationship is a composition, which cannot loop back on itself, so a product cannot be listed as an ingredient of itself, directly or through other products.
Every line of a formulation carries the one version number it belongs to.

must_record: The same information, read starting from an ingredient
must_answer: Which products contain this ingredient, by any route?

must_record: How much of each ingredient is used, and whether it may go at the end of the list
must_answer: In what order must this product's ingredients be declared, and which may go at the end?

must_record: Which alternatives may stand in for an ingredient, the conditions for using each, and what using it changes on the label
must_answer: Which alternatives are permitted for this ingredient, and what does using one change on the label?
must_prevent: An alternative recorded without saying what it changes on the label
prevent_how: Every permitted alternative must state what using it changes on the label.

must_record: Where an ingredient is bought in already made, who supplies it and what the supplier says is inside it
must_answer: Which of our products rest on an ingredient whose contents only the supplier can declare?

must_record: Each size and pack as its own product, linked to its family, with what makes it differ
Each change to a product, whether it made a different product or a new version, and why
must_answer: Which packs of this product exist, and did this change make a different product?

must_record: Every item that must appear on pack for a product in a market, and what it says
The business named on the pack as answerable for the product
must_answer: Is everything this market requires on this pack present, and what does each item say?
must_prevent: A pack item recorded for a market the product is not sold in
prevent_how: Every pack item belongs to a market the product is sold in.

must_record: Each allergen an ingredient carries, named by the food it comes from and by the market whose list it belongs to
must_answer: Which allergens must this product declare, and which ingredient brings each one?
must_prevent: A product declared free of an allergen one of its ingredients carries
prevent_how: A product's allergens are worked out from everything in its formulation, so an allergen that an ingredient carries cannot be left off.

must_record: Each nutrition value shown on pack, how it was arrived at, and how far it may vary
For a calculated value, the allowance made for the edible part, for weight change in preparation and for nutrient loss
must_answer: What are this product's nutrition values, how was each arrived at, and how far may each vary?
must_prevent: A nutrition value shown without saying how it was arrived at
prevent_how: Every nutrition value must say how it was arrived at.

must_record: Each claim made, the market it is made in, the nutrient and condition it rests on, and the product it is compared with where it compares
must_answer: Which claims does this pack make, and what does each rest on?
must_prevent: A claim made without the condition it rests on being stated
prevent_how: Every claim must state the condition it rests on.

must_record: Each version of what a product or ingredient must be, with its limits
must_answer: What must this ingredient be, and what did it have to be on a past date?

must_record: What a supplier's document says about what it supplied, who issued it and when, and whether the organisation checked it
must_answer: Which of this ingredient's stated properties did we check, and which did we take on the supplier's word?
Which supplier documents about an ingredient are newer than the formulation of a product that uses it?
must_prevent: A supplier's statement shown as though the organisation had checked it
prevent_how: Every supplier statement must say whether the organisation checked it.

must_record: How long a product, ingredient or part-made good lasts under each storage condition, and which date mark it carries
must_answer: How long does this last under each storage condition, and which date mark does it carry?

must_record: Each supplier authorised for each ingredient or packaging item, under which programme, and for what period
must_answer: Which suppliers may supply this ingredient today, and which could on a past date?
Which ingredients and packaging items have no authorised supplier?
must_prevent: An authorisation treated as current after it has lapsed
prevent_how: Every supplier authorisation has a start and an end date, so a lapsed authorisation is never treated as current.

must_record: Each ingredient's fraud-risk assessment, what it found, and the extra checks it calls for
must_answer: Which ingredients are most at risk of fraud, and what is in place for them?

must_record: Each certification a product holds, who granted it, and the period it is valid for
must_answer: Which certifications does this product hold, from whom, and are they still valid?
must_prevent: A certification shown as current after it has lapsed
prevent_how: Every certification has a start and an end date, so a lapsed certification is never shown as current.

must_record: The identifiers a product carries, who issued each, and the period each was in use
must_answer: Which product is this, whatever identifier the retailer or supplier used?

must_record: Where a country of origin is declared, which country and what it rests on
must_answer: Where does this ingredient or product come from, as declared?

must_record: Which products are the sizes, formats and pack counts of one product definition
Which products are only groupings, never made, bought or sold
must_answer: Which products are sold as versions of this product definition, and how does each differ?
must_prevent: A product that belongs to two product definitions
prevent_how: A product belongs to at most one product definition.

must_record: Every factory and supplier site: its name, its address and country, and its global location number where it has one
Which company runs each site, and from when
must_answer: Which company runs this site, and which sites does this company run?
must_prevent: A site run by two companies at the same time
withdrawn_reason: Moved to the manufacturing model: factories, the places inside them down to the shop floor, supplier sites, batches and supply chain detail belong there. This model holds a supplier only as a company.
prevent_how: A site has one operating company at a time. A change of company starts a new period.

must_record: Which version of a product's recipe each factory uses, and from when
must_answer: Which recipe version is this factory using for this product, and which was it using on a given date?
must_prevent: A product made at a factory with no recipe version named
withdrawn_reason: Moved to the manufacturing model: factories, the places inside them down to the shop floor, supplier sites, batches and supply chain detail belong there. This model holds a supplier only as a company.
prevent_how: Every factory a product is made at names the recipe version it uses.

must_record: Which site each bought material comes from
The certification each site holds: scheme, certificate number, what it covers, who granted it and for what period
must_answer: Which sites holding a certificate supply this ingredient, and what does each certificate cover?
must_prevent: A site certification that does not say what it covers
withdrawn_reason: Moved to the manufacturing model: factories, the places inside them down to the shop floor, supplier sites, batches and supply chain detail belong there. This model holds a supplier only as a company.
prevent_how: Every site certification states what it covers.

must_record: Each market a product is intended for, named by country or by a wider region, and the dates it is sold there
The sales channels a product is sold through in each market, and the dates
must_answer: Where, and through which channels, is this product sold today?
must_prevent: A market named by neither a country nor a region, or by both
The same product listed twice in the same market for overlapping dates
prevent_how: Every market names a country or a region, and not both.
A product has one listing for each market and period.

must_record: Which of the fourteen allergens listed for Great Britain a product declares
must_answer: Which allergens must this pack declare in Great Britain?

must_record: The language each label item is printed in
must_answer: In which language is each mandatory item printed for each market?
must_prevent: A label item with no language stated
prevent_how: Every label item states its language.

must_record: Which business a pack names as responsible in each market, and from when
must_answer: Which business does this pack name as responsible in this market?
must_prevent: Two businesses named as responsible for the same product in the same market at the same time
prevent_how: A product names one responsible business for each market and period.

must_record: Each picture of a product: which side it shows, where the file is held, its file type and the date from which it is current
must_answer: Which pictures show this product, and which is the current front view?
must_prevent: Two current pictures of the same side of one product
prevent_how: A product has one picture of each side for each period.

must_record: The continents, the regions within each continent, and the region each country sits in
must_answer: Which countries are in this region?
must_prevent: A country that sits in two regions
withdrawn_reason: The placing of each country in a region of the world belongs to the universal core data model. This design names a market by country or by the European Union, and the design covers three markets.
prevent_how: Each country names one region.

must_record: For each allergen a product declares in a market, whether the product contains it or it may be present
How the allergen came to be associated with the product, in plain words
must_answer: Which allergens does this product contain, and which may it contain, in this market?
Why does this product carry this allergen?
must_prevent: The same allergen shown as both contained and possibly present for one product in one market
prevent_how: A product has one entry for each allergen in a market, and each entry has one status.

must_record: The lowest and highest temperature a product may be kept at under each storage condition
must_answer: At what temperature must this product be kept?

must_record: Each food that causes allergies, held once for all markets
For each allergen in a market's list, the food it is, or the group of foods it names
must_answer: Is the celery declared in one market the same food as the celery declared in another?
Which allergens in the markets' lists are this food?
must_prevent: A market allergen that is two foods at once
prevent_how: Each market allergen names one food, and where a market groups several foods it names the group.

must_record: For each consumer goods product, whether it is a grouping of related sizes and packs, a version that can be sold, or an ingredient that goes into another product
must_answer: Which of our products are groupings, which are versions that can be sold, and which are ingredients?
